items.headline: Nvidia reports quarterly earnings as Wall Street bets on another blowout AI quarter
items.detail: The chipmaker is expected to post revenue near $92 billion for its fiscal second quarter, up roughly 96 percent year over year, with investors focused on its outlook and any return of China data-centre sales.

items.headline: Meta settles landmark social media addiction trial with US states for $16.7 billion
items.detail: Meta and a coalition of state attorneys general reached a settlement in the federal trial over allegations the company misrepresented child-related mental health harms from Facebook and Instagram.

items.headline: Apple unveils new Mac mini with M6 chip, starting at $899
items.detail: The base model pairs the new M6 processor with 16GB of RAM and 256GB of storage, delivering up to four times faster AI performance, with pre-orders open and shipping from September 22.

items.headline: AI model hub Hugging Face reportedly explores a sale valuing it at $13 billion
items.detail: The startup has brought in a bank to sound out buyers at a valuation of $13 billion or more, nearly triple its 2023 price tag, though no deal has been reached.

items.headline: Waymo to launch driverless rides in Germany in 2027, its first EU market
items.detail: Alphabet's robotaxi unit will begin phased testing in Munich in the coming weeks, aiming to open commercial ride-hailing to the public by the end of next year.

items.headline: Lidl owner Schwarz Group plans billions-euro data centre in northern Germany
items.detail: The German retail conglomerate, through its Schwarz Digits division, is positioning itself as a 'digitally sovereign' alternative to US tech giants with a facility near Rostock.

items.headline: Alibaba launches Wan3.0 AI video model after record $10 billion share sale
items.detail: The new model can generate 30-second videos from documents, spreadsheets, slides and web pages, and follows the largest-ever primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company.

items.headline: China's MiniMax sees first-half revenue nearly quadruple as AI demand surges
items.detail: The AI startup's revenue rose 283 percent to $116.6 million in the six months to June, driven by surging demand for its low-cost, open-source-based models.

items.headline: China's Moonshot in talks with Microsoft, Amazon and Google over Kimi K3 revenue sharing
items.detail: The IPO-bound startup is seeking up to a 30 percent share of revenue from hosting its blockbuster open-weight model on the US cloud giants' platforms, in what could be a first for a Chinese AI firm.

items.headline: NSW mandates facial recognition for gaming venues in gambling reform package
items.detail: The state will require hotels and clubs with gaming machines to use facial recognition tied to a statewide exclusion register expected to be ready by 2028.
